title: brain record base
$comment: Shared vocabulary + the universal completeness law. Every record type allOf-refs $defs/record. Required fields here ARE the structural definition-of-done that satisfies R1 (one record per entity, has id+type), R3 (every record carries updated+status). Per-type schemas add the rest. additionalProperties is intentionally open: the brain is agnostic and additive, so domain fields (root_cause, fix, affected, ...) pass through. Completeness is enforced by `required`, never by forbidding extras.

state.$comment: Controlled, queryable status vocabulary. Powers R2/R9 list/query (e.g. `list --where status=open`). Rich human nuance goes in status_detail.

datestamp.$comment: Currency stamp (F3/R3). Absolute date, never relative.

id.$comment: Stable unique key (F1/R1: one record per entity). kebab slug or ticket id; dots allowed for subtask ids (4.1).

rel.$comment: Edge relation vocabulary (F2/R2: traversable graph). task->decision->issue->artifact chains.

edge_ref.$comment: Adjacency-in-record edge. The LINKER extracts these on write so links are never hand-typed. (Edge STORAGE — inline vs join table — is the P0/P1 open item; this fixes the SHAPE either way.)

todo_item.$comment: One operational to-do / backlog / subtask line. The triad's 'to-do'. Carries its own status so a list/query can filter open work (R9).

record.$comment: The universal completeness law. allOf-referenced by every non-edge record type.

status_detail.$comment: Free-text nuance behind the controlled status (e.g. 'awaiting staging burn-in + prod deploy').

edges.$comment: Adjacency edges. Present (even if empty) makes every record edge-aware (R2).
